post.summary: Create a one-use Lumi Telegram account link
post.description: Authenticated account only. The link expires after ten minutes. Account signing keys stay in the app.

get.summary: Claim the next app action or owner feedback message
get.description: Requires a stable 64-character app client identifier. Each update belongs to one executor. Owner feedback is restricted to the configured immutable account ID.

200.description: Link status and next claimed update

post.summary: Acknowledge an action claimed by this app client
Mirror a new Lumi conversation message to the linked Telegram chat
post.description: Idempotent per account and message ID. Pending feedback carries Yes/No buttons. Messages from before linking are not replayed unsolicited. An uncertain external send is kept for inspection instead of automatically duplicated.

post.summary: Accept private-chat updates from the dedicated Lumi bot
post.description: Requires X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token. Only numeric sender identities in their own private chats are accepted. Duplicate update IDs cannot execute a second action.

get.summary: Read the issuing node and production bot identity
get.description: Issuing-node only. Entries expire after ten minutes. Telegram identity is verified server-side; no owner private key or recovery passphrase is accepted. Status, cancel and bind require fresh one-use key proofs. Bind additionally requires an existing owner bearer and unchanged v6 owner/device transaction signatures.

post.summary: Discover an owner authorization request using a fresh verified delegate proof
post.description: Issuing-node only. Requires the same verified numeric Telegram sender and delegate signing/encryption keys as the expiring bot entry. Each proof is bound to the entry, action, node, audience, expiry and one-use nonce. URL possession alone cannot poll. The response contains only expiring authorization rendezvous metadata; account identity, numeric sender, private keys and recovery data are never returned. This discovery does not approve a grant.

202.description: Verified entry is waiting for an owner authorization request

401.description: Verified delegate proof rejected or expired

409.description: Proof replayed or current account binding conflicts
